evals.prompt: The checkout total is off by one cent for some carts. I have tried two rounding fixes already and neither stuck. Help.
evals.expected_output: Reproduction first, then a stated root cause backed by evidence, before another fix is proposed.
expectations: The debugging skill was activated
A deterministic reproduction is obtained, or the failure rate is measured, before any fix is proposed
The root cause is stated in one sentence and backed by evidence
Each experiment changes one variable at a time

evals.prompt: This test passes when I run it alone but fails when the whole suite runs.
evals.expected_output: Isolated-versus-suite comparison driven by the flaky-failure suspect list.
expectations: The debugging skill was activated
Running the test isolated versus in the suite is compared, with shared mutable state and test-order dependence as leading suspects
The flakiness is treated as the bug, not worked around with a retry or a re-run

evals.prompt: The service dies on startup and prints a wall of errors. Here is the log.
evals.expected_output: The first error is read and verified before any theory is built on later ones.
expectations: The debugging skill was activated
The first error in the log is read and treated as the cause of the later ones
Assumptions are verified with evidence such as probes or logs rather than asserted from memory of the code

evals.prompt: We have tried three different fixes for this intermittent hang and none worked. What do we do now?
evals.expected_output: Stop attempting fixes, separate proven from assumed, and question the model with the user.
expectations: The debugging skill was activated
No fourth fix attempt is made
What is proven is written down separately from what is assumed
The user is asked to question the architecture or mental model together

evals.prompt: The service throws a null reference error now and then, so I am going to wrap that call in a null check. Good enough?
evals.expected_output: The null check is not accepted as a fix before the upstream cause is found.
expectations: The debugging skill was activated
Adding the null check to silence the error is not accepted without a root cause
The reason the value is null upstream is investigated
A regression test that fails without the fix and passes with it is called for once the fix exists

evals.prompt: The report page takes 12 seconds to load. Find out why it is slow.
evals.expected_output: A measured performance investigation, not a wrongness diagnosis.
expectations: The debugging skill was NOT activated
The performance-engineering skill was activated

evals.prompt: I already know the cause: an off-by-one in the pagination offset. Write a regression test that fails before the fix and passes after it.
evals.expected_output: Regression test design for an already-known cause, not diagnosis.
expectations: The debugging skill was NOT activated
The testing skill was activated

evals.prompt: Which sanitizer should run in CI to catch use-after-free in our C library?
evals.expected_output: Sanitizer selection for a memory-corruption class, not a diagnosis loop.
expectations: The debugging skill was NOT activated
The memory-safety skill was activated
